body.prompt: Close framing on his torso and hands, camera nearly still. As he talks, both hands move naturally: the right hand gestures with the pen held loosely, the left hand taps the desk once lightly and opens toward the viewer. Keep the exact same man, navy two-piece suit, white shirt, wide dark silk tie, white pocket square, watch, microphone and library background as the reference image. Black and white, soft film grain, warm light from above. The framing stays at or below the shirt collar the whole time: never tilt up, never show the chin, jaw, mouth or face. He never writes; the notebook stays untouched. Calm, natural movement. No text, no logos.
